displayDescription.en:
BenchCouncil lists CoCoOP in the LLM area of its AI100 (2022-2023) annual table. It associates the work with the publication “Conditional Prompt Learning for Vision-Language Models”. The page names Kaiyang Zhou, Ziwei Liu as the main contributors.

This Archive record preserves the official row order, citation value, institution, and country fields. It represents the annual 2022-2023 selection and remains separate from the long-term canonical AI100 storyline.
